blocks.text: Peak House is a residential treatment facility that provides a 10-week live-in program for adolescents aged 13 to 18 who want to overcome their addiction to drugs or alcohol. The program is voluntarily entered into by residents who have made a conscious decision to seek help. Pacific Youth and Family Services Society runs the program with support from the Vancouver Coastal Health Authority. Being Carf accredited and licensed, Peak House is seen as a reputable choice for families seeking rehabilitation for their loved ones.
blocks.html: Peak House is a residential treatment facility that provides a 10-week live-in program for adolescents aged 13 to 18 who want to overcome their addiction to drugs or alcohol. The program is voluntarily entered into by residents who have made a conscious decision to seek help. blocks.text: The program at Peak House strikes a balance between therapeutic work and fun activities that help the residents rediscover activities that can be enjoyed without using drugs or alcohol. Residents receive individual and group counseling, participate in education programs, engage in physical activities, use holistic health techniques, and even get to listen to guest speakers. Arts and music are also part of the curriculum, as are regular outings to the community. Former residents have commended the approach, saying that it helps create the necessary mindset for success.

centre.name: Peak House
centre.about_html:
Peak House is a residential treatment facility that provides a 10-week live-in program for adolescents aged 13 to 18 who want to overcome their addiction to drugs or alcohol. The program is voluntarily entered into by residents who have made a conscious decision to seek help. Pacific Youth and Family Services Society runs the program with support from the Vancouver Coastal Health Authority. Being Carf accredited and licensed, Peak House is seen as a reputable choice for families seeking rehabilitation for their loved ones.

Therapeutic Activities:

The program at Peak House strikes a balance between therapeutic work and fun activities that help the residents rediscover activities that can be enjoyed without using drugs or alcohol. Residents receive individual and group counseling, participate in education programs, engage in physical activities, use holistic health techniques, and even get to listen to guest speakers. Arts and music are also part of the curriculum, as are regular outings to the community. Former residents have commended the approach, saying that it helps create the necessary mindset for success.

Home-like Campus:

The cheerful campus of Peak House is in a residential area of Vancouver, British Columbia, reminding the residents that they are part of a larger community. The facility features a big backyard, a full kitchen, a living room, seven bedrooms with eight beds, and two group rooms, with a decor that is warm and welcoming. The ambiance of the house fosters a sense of safety that residents find comforting. Being an LGBT+ affirming facility, it is inclusive where diversity is celebrated.

 

Peak House - Center Overview

Peak House is a leading rehab center that specializes in youth treatment for those facing substance misuse challenges. The center offers a ten-week voluntary program that provides a live-in treatment experience for youth from across British Columbia. Peak House operates within the harm reduction spectrum and utilizes a trauma-informed, client-centered, and social justice framework that promotes lasting change and growth for program participants.

One feature that sets Peak House apart is its collaborative, youth-driven, and community-based model of care. The program is rooted in honoring the wisdom and expertise of young persons and families, promoting social justice-informed approaches to therapy and counseling. Peak House has earned significant recognition in the addiction treatment industry including being accredited by CARF, licensed, and receiving awards like the Addiction Specialists & Allied Professionals of British Columbia (ASAP) Award of Excellence and the BC Association of Clinical Counselors Professional Care Award.

The team at Peak House is proud to have been a part of the BC community for over three decades and continues to evolve to better serve the needs of youth and families facing substance misuse challenges. The rehab center has played a significant role in promoting change that lasts over time, making a meaningful difference in the lives of program participants and their families.

• Yoga

Aftercare

• Family Follow-up Counseling

Amenities

Special Considerations

Frequently Asked Questions About Peak House

What is the minimum and maximum stay duration?

The Peak House program lasts ten weeks; there is no minimum stay.

What makes Peak House different from other facilities?

Peak House is a home-like facility that caters to the individual needs of teens struggling with addiction. The therapeutic approach, the recreational activities, and the skilled professionals make it unique.

Can residents use their mobile phones?

Yes, but they have to respect the facility’s guidelines and schedule.

What happens after the program ends?

The aftercare team provides ongoing support and follow up for up to two years after graduation.

Are the staff trained?

The staff at Peak House are trained, experienced professionals in counseling and substance abuse.

raw_html:
Peak House is a residential treatment facility that provides a 10-week live-in program for adolescents aged 13 to 18 who want to overcome their addiction to drugs or alcohol. The program is voluntarily entered into by residents who have made a conscious decision to seek help. Pacific Youth and Family Services Society runs the program with support from the Vancouver Coastal Health Authority. Being Carf accredited and licensed, Peak House is seen as a reputable choice for families seeking rehabilitation for their loved ones.

Therapeutic Activities:

The program at Peak House strikes a balance between therapeutic work and fun activities that help the residents rediscover activities that can be enjoyed without using drugs or alcohol. Residents receive individual and group counseling, participate in education programs, engage in physical activities, use holistic health techniques, and even get to listen to guest speakers. Arts and music are also part of the curriculum, as are regular outings to the community. Former residents have commended the approach, saying that it helps create the necessary mindset for success.

Home-like Campus:

The cheerful campus of Peak House is in a residential area of Vancouver, British Columbia, reminding the residents that they are part of a larger community. The facility features a big backyard, a full kitchen, a living room, seven bedrooms with eight beds, and two group rooms, with a decor that is warm and welcoming. The ambiance of the house fosters a sense of safety that residents find comforting. Being an LGBT+ affirming facility, it is inclusive where diversity is celebrated.

 

Peak House - Center Overview

Peak House is a leading rehab center that specializes in youth treatment for those facing substance misuse challenges. The center offers a ten-week voluntary program that provides a live-in treatment experience for youth from across British Columbia. Peak House operates within the harm reduction spectrum and utilizes a trauma-informed, client-centered, and social justice framework that promotes lasting change and growth for program participants.

One feature that sets Peak House apart is its collaborative, youth-driven, and community-based model of care. The program is rooted in honoring the wisdom and expertise of young persons and families, promoting social justice-informed approaches to therapy and counseling. Peak House has earned significant recognition in the addiction treatment industry including being accredited by CARF, licensed, and receiving awards like the Addiction Specialists & Allied Professionals of British Columbia (ASAP) Award of Excellence and the BC Association of Clinical Counselors Professional Care Award.

The team at Peak House is proud to have been a part of the BC community for over three decades and continues to evolve to better serve the needs of youth and families facing substance misuse challenges. The rehab center has played a significant role in promoting change that lasts over time, making a meaningful difference in the lives of program participants and their families.

Frequently Asked Questions About Peak House

What is the minimum and maximum stay duration?

The Peak House program lasts ten weeks; there is no minimum stay.

What makes Peak House different from other facilities?

Peak House is a home-like facility that caters to the individual needs of teens struggling with addiction. The therapeutic approach, the recreational activities, and the skilled professionals make it unique.

Can residents use their mobile phones?

Yes, but they have to respect the facility’s guidelines and schedule.

What happens after the program ends?

The aftercare team provides ongoing support and follow up for up to two years after graduation.

Are the staff trained?

The staff at Peak House are trained, experienced professionals in counseling and substance abuse.
